highlights.title: Widgets & Siri
highlights.description: Twelve Home Screen widgets on iPhone and Android, from Continue Listening and Ayah of the Day to Tasbeeh and an interactive adhkar session. iPhone adds Lock Screen widgets, Control Center controls and Siri

highlights.title: CarPlay & Android Auto
highlights.description: Browse and play your reciters, surahs, playlists and downloads from your car’s screen, or just ask with your voice

highlights.title: Now in Arabic
highlights.description: The app is available in Arabic with a right-to-left layout. It follows your device language, or pick one in Settings › Language

highlights.title: Adhkar, Anywhere
highlights.description: Play All keeps going across the app and on your Lock Screen, with a Live Activity on iPhone. Morning, Evening and Quranic duas are now recited by Mishary Rashid Alafasy

highlights.title: Mushaf 1440
highlights.description: A new beta mushaf with the look of the printed Madinah mushaf and a preview of tajweed coloring, plus text thickness, Allah’s name highlighting and two new reading themes

highlights.title: Redesigned for iPad
highlights.description: A sidebar replaces the tab bar, the player opens as a split view, and landscape shows two facing mushaf pages like a printed mushaf

highlights.title: Smarter Search
highlights.description: Every search bar puts the best match first, forgives typos, ignores diacritics, and understands surah numbers and nicknames like “tabarak”

features: Twelve Home Screen widgets on iPhone and Android: Continue Listening, Continue Reading, Quick Surah, Pinned Reciter, Ayah of the Day, Tasbeeh, Recently Played, Library, Bedtime, Reciter of the Day, Morning & Evening Adhkar and Bayaan Now
The Morning & Evening Adhkar widget walks you through a session and counts each dhikr without opening the app
iPhone Lock Screen widgets for Now Listening, Verse of the Day, Tasbeeh and Continue Reading
Play or Pause and Play Surah controls for Control Center, the Lock Screen and the Action Button (iOS 18)
Ask Siri to play a surah, pause or resume
CarPlay and Android Auto: browse Home, Library, Reciters and Surahs, see the current ayah and Up Next on Now Playing, and make voice requests
Arabic interface with a right-to-left layout, Arabic-Indic digits and Arabic surah, reciter and adhkar names. Choose System default, English or العربية in Settings › Language
Adhkar Play All now plays app-wide, across tabs and with the screen locked, with a mini player on the Adhkar screen and a Continue Listening card on Home
Adhkar on the Lock Screen and in Control Center with next and previous, plus a Live Activity on iPhone that shows where you are in the list
Morning, Evening and all 40 Quranic duas are now recited by Mishary Rashid Alafasy, along with 23 more Hisn al-Muslim screens
Mushaf 1440 (beta) in Mushaf Settings › Font, with a preview of tajweed coloring and two-page spreads on iPad
Text Thickness: Normal, Medium or Bold Arabic text in the mushaf, player, word-by-word and share images
Divine Names: highlight Allah and Rabb in gold, emerald, blue or rose
Two new reading themes: Sand and Dark Amber
iPad redesign: sidebar navigation, a split-view player, readable page widths, and two facing mushaf pages in landscape
The mushaf now rotates to landscape on iPhone, filling the width and keeping your place
One ranked search behind every search bar: best match first, typo-tolerant, diacritic-insensitive, and aware of surah numbers and nicknames
Redesigned reciter profile header with Play all, Shuffle, Favorite and Download buttons
Download all of a reciter’s surahs in one tap, with progress and cancel
New reciter picker for mushaf playback and Favorite Reciters, with one row per rewayah
A Share anonymous usage data switch in Settings › Privacy to turn off analytics
improvements: Non-Hafs rewayat use their own verse numbers and opening basmala in titles, bookmarks, notes, search and the player
Show Differences tints whole words that read differently from Hafs, plus silah marks, with a matching color legend
Clear messages instead of silent fallbacks, like “Showing in Hafs” and “Verse tracking unavailable”, and a Try again option when a rewayah or the mushaf can’t load
Bookmarked verses stay tinted on Madani and IndoPak pages, with your own highlights on top
The Follow Along badge now shows on Home and Browse reciter cards
Evening adhkar has its own evening wording and recordings
Cleaner adhkar text: no more (( )) markers, Quran passages in Digital Khatt, transliterations from published sources, and 99 Names meanings with Quran references
Copying or sharing a dhikr gives clean text with only the reading aids you have turned on
Adhkar audio volume is more even
The mini player’s play/pause is its own button for VoiceOver and TalkBack
Translations & Tafaseer tells you when a download is already in progress
Lower memory use in the mushaf during long reading sessions
fixes: Rewayat text rebuilt from the official King Fahd Complex sources, fixing missing or repeated words, verse numbers, highlights and Hafs text showing under another rewayah
Mushaf lines reach both margins, marks under the last line are no longer cut off, and highlights draw as one clean band
Surahs that start partway down a page, like Al-Ikhlas, show their own name in the header
The page-by-page mushaf shows whether a verse is bookmarked and no longer saves the same bookmark twice
Mushaf playback settings: start and end verses can’t end up reversed, your speed no longer resets to 1x, and the lists scroll without closing the sheet
Tapping several surahs quickly no longer plays the wrong one or plays twice
Slower Android phones no longer freeze when playback starts
Screens with a sheet no longer stop responding to taps on slower Android phones
Reciter profiles no longer get stuck on loading placeholders on some Android screens
Continue Listening shows seconds for short surahs instead of “0m”
Reciter photos from the catalog show instead of a generic icon
The last row in Browse All is no longer hidden behind the mini player
Collection options that open another sheet, like Edit Note, no longer flash open and close
Using verse actions in the player no longer closes the player
Switching away from the Dark theme no longer leaves the app stuck in dark mode
Adhkar Play All no longer stalls on very short clips, and it follows your swipes
Adhkar text fixes: repeat counts, translations, missing text and a typo in eight translations
Favorite Reciters search keeps the keyboard up, and its search button works on Android
Links from shares and widgets open with a working Back button and no duplicate tab bar
The Reading Theme and Adhkar screens no longer start underneath the header
What’s New shows the right release date in every time zone
technical: Minimum iOS is now 16.4. Widgets, Lock Screen widgets, the Live Activity and Siri phrases need iOS 17 or later
Expo SDK 57, React Native 0.86 and the React Compiler
Follow-along ayah timings served from Bayaan’s own CDN
Rewayah databases ship as checksummed copies that repair themselves and switch atomically
Mushaf memory: Skia paragraphs are disposed and the page-layout cache is bounded
The notes table is no longer rebuilt on every launch
Language registry with CI checks for every shipped language; Android restarts the process to apply a new language
Scene-based iOS app lifecycle and a headless start for car launches
Android no longer declares unused photo and video permissions
Sentry release tags and start-up breadcrumbs; reciter name on playback analytics events
What’s New release pages can be marked update-only so they stay out of the first-launch tour

highlights.title: Bayaan is now Open Source
highlights.description: Bayaan is now AGPL-3.0 and on GitHub. Star the repo, report issues, or open a pull request. Link in Settings › About Bayaan

highlights.title: 7 More Rewayat
highlights.description: Read the mushaf in Warsh, Qalun, Al-Bazzi, Qunbul, Shu'bah, Al-Duri, and Al-Susi alongside Hafs, with per-letter and whole-word diff highlighting

highlights.title: Rewayah Everywhere
highlights.description: The player renders verse text in the currently-playing rewayah, saved bookmarks remember which rewayah they were made in, and a toast tells you when it switches

highlights.title: Share Anything
highlights.description: New share buttons on verses, surahs, mushaf pages, reciters, recitations, adhkar, and dhikr. Deep links open straight back into the app

highlights.title: Surahs Tab
highlights.description: A dedicated tab for the whole mushaf, with juz groupings and a continue-reading hero that remembers where you left off

features: Bayaan is now open source at github.com/thebayaan/Bayaan under AGPL-3.0; a new Contribute on GitHub link in Settings › About Bayaan opens the repo
7 new rewayat with full mushaf text and diff highlighting: Shu'bah, Al-Bazzi, Qunbul, Warsh, Qalun, Al-Duri (Abu Amr), Al-Susi. 8 rewayat with text in total, Hafs included
Canonical rewayah identity module with support for all 20 qira'at narrations; the 12 text-less rewayat appear in the picker as audio-only entries
Rewayah-aware player: verse text renders in the currently-playing rewayah; bookmarks, notes, highlights, and share URLs carry the rewayah stamp
Char-level tajweed highlights for Warsh/Qalun (madd al-badal, tashil, ibdal, taghliz al-lam, silah) plus whole-word mukhtalif tinting for Al-Duri/Al-Susi
"Now reading" toast when the currently-playing track's rewayah transitions
Consistent foreground diff highlighting across paginated mushaf, vertical mushaf, and list modes. Previously only the paginated view painted them
Collapsible accordion for the rewayat picker in mushaf settings with the diff toggle promoted above it; color legend disclosure per rewayah
Shareable deep links for verses, surahs, mushaf pages, reciters, recitations, adhkar super-categories, and individual dhikr. All open back into the app
Share buttons in player options, surah options, verse actions, mushaf header, adhkar index, dhikr screen, and the recent-reciter long-press sheet
Theme-aware Open Graph images (light/dark) generated server-side with custom fonts for surah and verse share links
New Surahs tab with juz groupings, continue-reading hero that resumes at your last-read page, and shared gradient-mesh styling with the hero
Listening insights: anonymous PostHog analytics (30s/10% meaningful-listen threshold) with opt-out, Sentry crash reporting, local MMKV aggregation for offline events
Bayaan backend API integration for reciter catalog. App now pulls from api.thebayaan.com with a local bundled fallback and cache
Community-fork friendly: app runs without an API key using the bundled fallback catalog
iOS 26 Liquid Glass treatment for the search-tab browse tiles
Cross-platform network-status toasts on connection loss, recovery, and backend-fallback transitions. Replaces the persistent pill banner
Share recent-played recitation from the reciter long-press sheet with reciter + surah + rewayah context
improvements: iOS 26 polish pass: inset handling across scroll views, search-keyboard edge cases, surah-card cleanup
Mini-player auto-collapses on scroll in the mushaf-settings and search tabs (iOS 26)
Adhkar cards now show titles below the artwork with sharper corners, preserving the home-screen vertical rhythm
Clearer 'Add reciter to favorites' vs 'Add to loved' labels in the recent-reciter sheet; heart icon for loved is bigger
Review and Learn About icons render at full text color (were previously dimmed by hardcoded opacity)
Adhkar See More button, rewayah-aware navigation context, and canonical category ordering
Rewayah displayed in mushaf header meta
Quran tab icon resized for visual balance
Cached reciter data is used immediately on startup (no blank state while the API responds)
fixes: Recovered users stuck on a stale pre-canonical rewayah slug ("qaloon", "shouba", etc.) where the mushaf would fail to load
Android toasts now show the full text instead of dropping the subtitle line
Explore-tab bento tiles no longer double-pad under the iOS 26 search bar
Share sheet from the recent-reciter options no longer conflicts with the dismissing action sheet
Fixed 4 codepoints that weren't in the DigitalKhatt font (substituted cleanly)
Android crash on setColorScheme(null); settings top-inset fix
Adhkar header styling and settings-screen scroll behavior
What's New onboarding now filters by version
TrackInfo navigation cleanup and hydration timeout fallback
Floating player, player-sheet header, and upload UI refinements
technical: License switched from Apache 2.0 + Commons Clause to AGPL-3.0-or-later; added TRADEMARKS.md separating code license from brand protection
Open-source governance files added; bundled reciters.json removed (streams from API instead); unused fonts removed
Cloudflare R2 audio CDN migration with slug-based URL resolution and cache-busting backwards compatibility
Analytics infrastructure: PostHog SDK + device-ID generation + event schema + local aggregation + meaningful-listen tracking
Analytics killswitch + privacy manifest + build hardening
Shared RewayahDiffService.getRewayahRuleMapForLine / getRewayahRuleMapForWords consumed by all three mushaf renderers
Defensive migratePersistedId guards in DigitalKhattDataService and MushafPreloadService init paths so corrupted persisted slugs self-heal
Normalized alef/yeh variants in the mukhtalif classifier; multi-category tajweed classifier for far rewayat
ApiDisruptionBanner replaced by NetworkStatusMonitor: headless, transition-only toast emitter
burnt toast wrapper accepts a preset argument; Android merges title+message into a single line since Toast.makeText only renders one string
Build 697 (iOS); ShareExtension bumped to 2.1.2
